response.justification: Bogdan has extensive experience in software engineering, including leadership in AI-agent infrastructure and cloud-native development, but lacks explicit AI/ML product development, entrepreneurial experience in larger organizations, or recognized AI expertise. His background in GIS and open-source contributions is strong but not directly aligned with the AI strategy focus required for this role.
strengths: 15+ years of software engineering experience across diverse domains (web, mobile, embedded, and cloud).
Strong technical leadership in building scalable systems (e.g., GISCollective, AI-agent infrastructure at re:cinq).
Proven ability to work with modern tools and frameworks (TypeScript, Node.js, Kubernetes, Docker).
concerns: No clear evidence of AI/ML product development or recognized expertise in AI (e.g., publications, patents, or widely adopted AI platforms).
Limited entrepreneurial or startup experience within larger organizations, which is a preferred qualification.
Education lacks advanced AI-related degrees (Master's/PhD), though practical experience compensates partially.
